parsed.rationale: Two of the four participating records live in 'Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift' (package: Artwork), which is a test file. Under the decision rules, any cluster containing even one test-resident record must be treated as a test-fixture and no refactor should be recommended. Lifting the CGImage extensions from ArtworkServiceTests.swift into shared production code (e.g., Core) would couple production infrastructure to test-only helpers. The two Image extensions in 'Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Models and Services/ImageCompatability.swift' may themselves warrant consolidation within that file, but that is a separate, intra-file concern not surfaced by this cluster.
